import MumfordLib.SingularSmallCohomology
import MumfordLib.SingularSmallChainsAPI
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyPullback

/-! Cohomology comparisons for a two-set open cover. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable (X : TopCat)

def singularSubsetCohomologyIso (U : Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSimplicialCohomology (singularSubset X U) n ≅
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of U) n :=
  simplicialCohomologyIso (singularSubsetIso X U) n

def singularSubsetMap {U V : Set X} (h : U ⊆ V) : TopCat.of U ⟶ TopCat.of V :=
  TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun x => ⟨x.1, h x.2⟩, continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _⟩

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularSubsetMap_inclusion {U V : Set X} (h : U ⊆ V) :
    singularSubsetMap X h ≫ singularSubsetInclusion X V =
      singularSubsetInclusion X U := rfl

@[reassoc]
theorem singularSubsetIso_naturality {U V : Set X} (h : U ⊆ V) :
    (singularSubsetIso X U).hom ≫
        SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (singularSubset_mono X h) =
      TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetMap X h) ≫ (singularSubsetIso X V).hom := by
  apply (cancel_mono (singularSubset X V).ι).mp
  simp [← Functor.map_comp]

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPullback_toSSet {Y Z : TopCat} (f : Y ⟶ Z) :
    integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map f) =
      integralSingularCochainPullback f := rfl

@[reassoc]
theorem singularSubsetCohomologyIso_restriction (U : Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (singularSubset X U).ι) n ≫
        (singularSubsetCohomologyIso X U n).hom =
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback (singularSubsetInclusion X U)) n := by
  change homologyMap _ n ≫
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (singularSubsetIso X U).hom) n = _
  rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]
  rfl

theorem integralSingularCochainUnionRestriction_quasiIso
    (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) :
    QuasiIso (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
      (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V).ι) := by
  let W : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex := singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V
  change QuasiIso (integralSimplicialCochainPullback W.ι)
  rw [show W = smallSingularSubcomplex X (fun b : Bool => if b then U else V) by
    symm; exact smallSingularSubcomplex_two X U V]
  apply integralSmallSingularCochainRestriction_quasiIso
  · intro b
    cases b <;> assumption
  · intro x
    have hx : x ∈ U ∪ V := hcover ▸ Set.mem_univ x
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact ⟨true, hx⟩
    · exact ⟨false, hx⟩

def singularUnionCohomologyIso
    (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology X n ≅
      IntegralSimplicialCohomology ((singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V :
        (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex)) n := by
  letI := integralSingularCochainUnionRestriction_quasiIso X U V hU hV hcover
  exact isoOfQuasiIsoAt (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
      (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V :
        (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex).ι) n

@[simp]
theorem singularUnionCohomologyIso_hom
    (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom =
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
        (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V).ι) n := rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
